verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's plan docs describe a destroy mode that builds a plan to destroy all remote objects that exist and leave an empty state, explicitly recommended for transient development environments [opentofu-docs-5][opentofu-docs-35]. A saved plan can then be executed with `tofu apply` [opentofu-docs-21], and `tofu test` also auto-destroys the resources it creates [opentofu-docs-7]. Missing for 10: an explicit standalone `tofu destroy` command page in the evidence, details on teardown ordering and partial-failure handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
